# Setup

```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(survey)
library(sampling)
library(here)

repo_root <- here::here()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo_root)

source(file.path(repo_root, "code", "sampling_functions.R"))
source(file.path(repo_root, "code", "utils.R"))
source(file.path(repo_root, "code", "models", "ciginas.R"))

response_var <- "PUBCOV"
alpha <- 0.05
X_formula <- as.formula("~ AGEP_binned + RAC1P + SEX")
```

This notebook uses the shared notebook test fixture in `data/test_sample.RData` so it stays aligned with the other model notebooks.

At the moment, that shared fixture is generated by `code/tests/create_test_sample.R`, which still uses the older AGEP-based NPS design rather than the current POVPIP-based hard/extreme setting in `main.R`.

# Model Specification

The simplified Ciginas estimator in this branch combines:

1. the direct PS estimate by PUMA,
2. an NPS-only IPW estimate using the weighted logistic propensity model,
3. a domain-specific mixing weight based on the PS variance and an NPS MSE proxy.

For PUMA $d$,

$$
\hat\theta_d^{\text{Cig}} = (1 - w_d)\hat\theta_d^{\text{PS}} + w_d\hat\theta_d^{\text{NPS-IPW}}
$$

with

$$
w_d = \frac{\widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\hat\theta_d^{\text{PS}})}{\widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\hat\theta_d^{\text{PS}}) + \widehat{\mathrm{MSE}}(\hat\theta_d^{\text{NPS-IPW}})}
$$

and

$$
\widehat{\mathrm{MSE}}(\hat\theta_d^{\text{NPS-IPW}}) = \widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\hat\theta_d^{\text{NPS-IPW}}) + (\hat\theta_d^{\text{NPS-IPW}} - \hat\theta_d^{\text{PS}})^2.
$$

This is a point-estimate-only prototype, so interval estimates are not implemented yet.

```{r show-core-code, eval=FALSE}
cat(readLines(file.path(repo_root, "code", "models", "ciginas.R")), sep = "\n")
```

# Fit Estimator

```{r fit}
ciginas_raw <- ciginas_out(
    ps = ps_df,
    nps = nps_df,
    X_formula = X_formula,
    response = response_var,
    ps_weight_var = "weights"
)
```

```{r diagnostics-summary}
ciginas_raw %>%
```

```{r first-rows}
ciginas_raw %>%

```

# Performance Comparison

## Direct Estimates Benchmark

```{r direct-estimates}
samp.design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~weights, data = ps_df)

direst <- svyby(
    as.formula(paste0("~", response_var)),
    ~PUMA,
    samp.design,
    svymean,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    vartype = "se",
    keep.names = FALSE
) %>%
    arrange(PUMA) %>%
    transmute(
        PUMA,
        point_est = .data[[response_var]],
        lower_CI = point_est + qnorm(alpha / 2) * se,
        upper_CI = point_est + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * se,
        model = "direst"
    )
```

## Assemble Comparison Results

```{r comparison-results}
ciginas_results <- ciginas_raw %>%
    select(PUMA, point_est, lower_CI, upper_CI, model)

nps_ipw_results <- ciginas_raw %>%
    transmute(
        PUMA,
        point_est = nps_ipw_est,
        lower_CI = NA_real_,
        upper_CI = NA_real_,
        model = "nps_ipw_component"
    )

all_results <- bind_rows(direst, ciginas_results, nps_ipw_results)
```

## Metrics

```{r int-score}
int_score <- function(alpha, y, lower, upper) {
    (upper - lower) +
        (2 / alpha) * (lower - y) * (y < lower) +
        (2 / alpha) * (y - upper) * (y > upper)
}
```

```{r metrics}
true_values %>%
    left_join(all_results, by = "PUMA") %>%
    group_by(model) %>%
    summarize(
        MSE = mean((response_true - point_est)^2, na.rm = TRUE),
        MAB = mean(abs(response_true - point_est), na.rm = TRUE),
        Coverage = mean(between(response_true, lower_CI, upper_CI), na.rm = TRUE),
        `Int. Score` = mean(int_score(alpha, response_true, lower_CI, upper_CI), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
```

## Estimates vs Truth

```{r estimates-vs-truth, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
true_values %>%
    left_join(all_results, by = "PUMA") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = response_true, y = point_est)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_CI, ymax = upper_CI), alpha = 0.15) +
    facet_wrap(~model) +
    labs(x = "True PUBCOV Rate", y = "Estimated PUBCOV Rate") +
    theme_minimal()
```

## Component Comparison by PUMA

```{r point-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
true_values %>%
    left_join(ciginas_raw %>% select(PUMA, ps_est, nps_ipw_est, point_est), by = "PUMA") %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(response_true, ps_est, nps_ipw_est, point_est),
        names_to = "series",
        values_to = "estimate"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = PUMA, y = estimate, color = series, group = series)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.3) +
    labs(
        title = "PUMA-level truth and component estimates",
        y = response_var,
        x = "PUMA",
        color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
```

## NPS Weight by PUMA

```{r weight-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
ciginas_raw %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(PUMA, weight_nps), y = weight_nps)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4C6A92") +
    labs(
        title = "Simplified Ciginas weight on NPS IPW component",
        x = "PUMA",
        y = "weight_nps"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
```
